items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: You know what Al Cohn said — no Carl Fontana said to Al Cohn...

ctx.x: It’s sort of like that thing we can do this but should we. So last question, John, when did you know that you had the beat? Because you’ve talked about the beat a lot today and was it something you think you were born with or was it early exposure with records?

The beat is an opinion. It’s an opinion, where you put it. And you try to adjust to what’s happening if you have to, but you have to stand your ground to a certain extent you know what I mean? It’s like it’s not infallible. So I don’t know I just try to keep time you know and try not to drag or rush. You know what Al Cohn said — no Carl Fontana said to Al Cohn, “I played with this drummer last night, every time we played with sticks he rushed and every time he played with brushes he’d drag.” And Al says, “Well…

I do too. Drummers, some drummers like to play with the time more than others. Not play the time, play with the time. And if you’re with somebody like that do you like dig in and say all right if you have to play with the time then I’m going to play the time for you to mess with?
